newsitem.title: FRANCE: GEC Alsthom wins 645 mln Ffr UK train contract.
newsitem.headline: GEC Alsthom wins 645 mln Ffr UK train contract.

text.p: Anglo-French joint venture GEC Alsthom said on Wednesday it has won a 645 million franc order to supply 27 diesel passenger train-sets for rail operator North Western Trains of Britain.
The contract includes an option for 50 more vehicles but the final configuration of these has not been decided, a GEC Alsthom spokeswoman said.
The train-sets will be produced at GEC Alsthom's workshops at Birmingham and will all be in service by 2000 in the northwest of England and north Wales.
They will replace a third of North Western's existing fleet and provide better accommodation for families and handicapped passengers. The trains will have a maximum speed of 200 km per hour.
The order was the biggest since privatisation of the railways in Britain, GEC Alsthom said.
GEC Alsthom is a 50/50 venture between General Electric Co Plc and Alcatel Alsthom.
